title: Reformat Code aligns struct fields, tags and comments
code:
package config

import "time"

type ScrapeConfig struct {
	<caret>JobName string `yaml:"job_name"` // the job
	ScrapeInterval time.Duration `yaml:"scrape_interval,omitempty"`
	HonorLabels bool `yaml:"honor_labels,omitempty"` // keep target labels
	SampleLimit uint `yaml:"sample_limit,omitempty"`
}
gofmtResult:
package config

import "time"

type ScrapeConfig struct {
	<caret>JobName        string        `yaml:"job_name"` // the job
	ScrapeInterval time.Duration `yaml:"scrape_interval,omitempty"`
	HonorLabels    bool          `yaml:"honor_labels,omitempty"` // keep target labels
	SampleLimit    uint          `yaml:"sample_limit,omitempty"`
}
